walkthrough:
Set up the midpoint formula with $B(n, -6)$ as the midpoint of $A(2, m)$ and $C(x, y)$:
$$\left(\frac{2 + x}{2}, \frac{m + y}{2}\right) = (n, -6)$$

Equate components to solve for $x$ and $y$ in terms of $m$ and $n$:
$$\frac{2 + x}{2} = n \implies x = 2n - 2$$
$$\frac{m + y}{2} = -6 \implies y = -12 - m$$

hints: Use $m_{AB} = -1$ since $AB$ is perpendicular to $y = x+1$ (gradient 1).
Solve the simultaneous equations $m + 2n = -11$ and $m - n = -8$.
walkthrough:
Substitute the coordinates of $C(2n - 2, -12 - m)$ into the line equation $y = x + 1$:
$$-12 - m = (2n - 2) + 1 \implies m + 2n = -11$$

Determine the gradient of the perpendicular segment $AB$ using the gradient of $y = x + 1$ ($m_1 = 1$):
$$m_{AB} = -\frac{1}{1} = -1$$

Set up the gradient formula for $AB$ with $A(2, m)$ and $B(n, -6)$:
$$\frac{-6 - m}{n - 2} = -1 \implies -6 - m = -(n - 2) \implies m - n = -8$$

Solve the simultaneous linear equations for $m$ and $n$:
$$(m + 2n) - (m - n) = -11 - (-8) \implies 3n = -3 \implies n = -1$$

Substitute $n = -1$ back into $m - n = -8$ to find $m$:
$$m - (-1) = -8 \implies m + 1 = -8 \implies m = -9$$

ai_rubric.Coordinate Geometry: Substitutes $C$ into $y=x+1$ to get $m+2n = -11$ (M1). Uses perpendicular gradient $m_{AB} = -1$ to get $m-n = -8$ (B1). Solves simultaneous equations (DM1). Obtains $m = -9$ (A1) and $n = -1$ (A1).
